evidence.quote: Do you confirm you want to return these 3 items from order #W2378156 for a total refund

observed_facts: The user requested to return the cleaner, headphones, and smart watch in step 1.
The agent confirmed all three items with the user in step 26.
The agent called return_delivered_order_items with only 2 of the 3 items in step 28.
Subsequent attempt to return the third item failed because the order status had changed to 'return requested'.
inference: The agent failed to include all items collected and confirmed by the user in the initial return tool call, leading to an incomplete return and subsequent tool error.
needs_verification: Whether the policy strictly requires all items to be submitted in a single call or if multiple calls were permitted before status change.
parsed.summary: The agent failed to include all three requested return items in the initial tool call after confirming them with the user, resulting in an incomplete return.
